title: UK police leaders to call for ‘non-crime hate incidents’ to be scrapped
summary: Review will request ‘commonsense’ system with most serious incidents recorded as antisocial behaviour The category of non-crime hate incidents is no longer fit for purpose and could be scrapped under plans to be presented to the home secretary. A review by police leaders will call for non-crime hate incidents to be replaced with a new “commonsense” system, the Telegraph reports. Under the new scheme, only the most serious incidents would be recorded as antisocial behaviour. Continue reading...

title: Spain’s CESGA Selects IQM and Telefónica to Deploy Advanced Quantum Computing Infrastructure
summary: IQM will deliver two full-stack quantum computers: a 54-qubits IQM Radiance system and a 5-qubit IQM Spark by June 2026. The systems will support research, skills development, and industrial access to quantum computers across multiple sectors. This will be the first installation of IQM quantum computers in Spain.
